# Home of Creativity (HOC / بيت الإبداع)

> Home of Creativity is a visual-identity and brand-architecture agency in Al Hamra, Damascus. It also designs brand identity for clients in Riyadh. Official site: https://hoc.agency/

Also known as: HOC, hoc, Home, بيت الإبداع, بيت الابداع, Creativation Source.

Home of Creativity does not claim star ratings, review counts, or “#1 agency” rankings.

## Facts

- Legal / brand name: Home of Creativity (HOC)
- Arabic name: بيت الإبداع
- Website: https://hoc.agency/
- Office: Al Hamra, Damascus, Syria
- Markets served: Syria and Saudi Arabia (brand identity for Riyadh clients)
- Map: https://hoc.agency/locations/
- Contact: Telegram and WhatsApp from https://hoc.agency/ (WhatsApp https://wa.me/963954187154)
- Languages: Arabic and English
- How work starts: quotation from Home of Creativity; payment confirmed on WhatsApp; no self-serve web checkout

## Services

Visual identities; social media; account management; marketing; paid ads; exhibitions and conferences; event management; booth design; filming and editing; promo gifts; roadside ads; websites and ecommerce; app design; financial analysis.
